About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## J.E. Pabon, MD, FACOG

Fertility Center & Applied Genetics of Florida and the offices of Julio E. Pabon, M.D., P.A.
(formerly Fertility Center of Sarasota) is an extremely unique private practice where patients
receive personal care from one Reproductive Endocrinologist and Infertility Specialist.

Our Medical and Laboratory Director, J. E. Pabon, M.D., F.A.C.O.G. takes the time to know his
patients, their history and their specific needs.

Dr. Pabon and the staff of Fertility Center and Applied Genetics of FL are happy to serve you in our
2 offices: one in Sarasota, FL and one in Bonita Springs, FL.

## IVF Procedure

The IVF procedure and embryo transfer involves the harvesting
of several oocytes (eggs)
from the ovaries.

Technology has advanced significantly in the past several years allowing couples the option of
selecting the sex of their next child.

Dr. Pabon has the training and experience that is needed to perform delicate microsurgical tubal
reversals efficiently and expertly.

## General Infertility

Approximately 15% of couples experience infertility. It is defined as the inability to conceive and
deliver a child after
one year of trying.

We have been performing PGS and PGD IVF since June of 2000. Our first live birth was
reported in 2001.

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

# Assisted Reproductive Technology
# to Bring Innovations to Life

Hamilton Thorne Inc. is a trusted provider of Sperm Analyzers, Laser Systems, and Equipment for In
Vitro Fertilization driven by Artificial Intelligence.

For Humans
Assisted reproductive technology solutions for the IVF clinic. Our knowledgeable sales team can
consult with you on a variety of ART solutions to meet your lab’s demanding needs.
[Learn More][155]
For Animals
We possess technical expertise in animal reproduction and create assisted reproductive technology to
meet your animal breeding needs. Ranging from applications in animal production, conservation,
veterinary care, and breeding for performance.
[Learn More][156]
For Research
We offer a full range of solutions to support research studies for various animal models. Our CASA
and laser systems have been used in toxicology, drug safety assessments, clinical research, stem
cell research, and other various developmental biology protocols.
[Learn More][157]

# Assisted Reproductive Technology
# to Bring Innovations to Life

Hamilton Thorne Inc. is a trusted provider of Sperm Analyzers, Laser Systems, and Equipment for In
Vitro Fertilization driven by Artificial Intelligence.

For Humans
Assisted reproductive technology solutions for the IVF clinic. Our knowledgeable sales team can
consult with you on a variety of ART solutions to meet your lab’s demanding needs.
[Learn More][155]
For Animals
We possess technical expertise in animal reproduction and create assisted reproductive technology to
meet your animal breeding needs. Ranging from applications in animal production, conservation,
veterinary care, and breeding for performance.
[Learn More][156]
For Research
We offer a full range of solutions to support research studies for various animal models. Our CASA
and laser systems have been used in toxicology, drug safety assessments, clinical research, stem
cell research, and other various developmental biology protocols.
[Learn More][157]

# Bringing a Boutique Fertility and IVF Center to the Heart of Houston

[Inovi Fertility Lobby]

> “I love seeing the transformation people undergo from being discouraged to seeing the ultrasound
> and hearing the heartbeat. This is a process that transforms lives.”
> 
> Dr. Stephan Krotz

## Welcome to The Inovi Family

### We see patients of all ages and genders, but they all have one thing in common — a desire to
### build their families.

We focus on providing upscale service and attention you may not get elsewhere. As a single physician
practice, you can feel comfortable knowing that your treatment will be carried out by the same
doctor and nursing staff. Dr. Krotz and our team are here for you through every step of your
fertility journey, from your evaluation to your treatment and beyond.

## Why Choose Inovi?

Many IVF clinics focus on numbers — we focus on service and helping you create the family of your
dreams. As a boutique practice, we can provide personalized care that goes above and beyond. We go
the extra mile to ensure a comforting, welcoming experience.
* Always see your doctor
* Evening, weekend and video appointments
* Most current technology offered
* Easy office communication
* Customized treatment protocols
* Spanish speaking doctor & staff
* All services in one location
* Accepts major insurances

###### Dr. Lynn Westphal

Lead CMO, Medicine + Research & REI
[View More][125]

Lynn Marie Westphal, M.D., FACOG, graduated summa cum laude from Lawrence University, earned her
M.D. degree at Stanford University, and did her residency training in obstetrics and gynecology at
UCLA and Stanford University. She did a fellowship in molecular biology at Stanford University and
completed her fellowship in Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI) at UCSF and is double
board-certified in Obstetrics and Gynecology/Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility. Dr.
Westphal joined the full-time faculty at Stanford University in 1998 and was a Professor in the
Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Director of the Fertility Preservation Program, Director of
the Third-Party Reproduction Program, and Director of the REI Fellowship. Her interest in fertility
preservation for cancer survivors led her to set up one of the first oocyte cryopreservation
programs in the country. She has held numerous national leadership positions and was the President
of the Fertility Preservation Special Interest Group of the American Society of Reproductive
Medicine from 2008-2009. She was the Director of Women’s Health at Stanford from 2005-2012. In 2012,
she co-founded the Stanford Center for Health Research on Women and Sex Differences in Medicine
(WSDM) and served as co-director of the program for two years.

[ View More ][126]

###### Dr. Amber Cooper

CMO, Genomics + Lab Operations & REI
[View More][127]

Dr. Amber R. Cooper, MD, MS is Chief Medical Officer-Genomics and Laboratory Sciences, and Medical
and IVF Practice Director, St. Louis. Prior to joining Kindbody, Dr. Cooper was a founding physician
and the Chief Medical Officer for the St. Louis region of Vios Fertility Institute. She understands
the challenges of infertility both personally and professionally. Board certified in both Obstetrics
and Gynecology and Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility, she completed both her residency and
fellowship at Washington University in St. Louis. During her years of practice, Dr. Cooper has
received numerous awards and has authored articles for several medical journals and textbooks.

She is a globally recognized expert on the topic of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to
increase access to fertility treatments. In 2022, Dr. Cooper presented at the first world conference
on AI and fertility in Croatia, and more recently spoke on the topic at The Middle East Fertility
Conference in Dubai.

Additionally, she has led clinical studies, had her research covered in the local and national
press, and spoken both nationally and internationally on various topics related to fertility. While
she is passionate for all facets of fertility health, she has a special interest in improving IVF
success and outcomes, fertility preservation, ovarian dysfunction, ovarian reserve and aging,
hysteroscopic surgery, genetics, and the environmental impact on ovarian aging and function.

Dr. Cooper serves patients from our St.

###### Dr. Lynn Westphal

Lead CMO, Medicine + Research & REI
[View More][125]

Lynn Marie Westphal, M.D., FACOG, graduated summa cum laude from Lawrence University, earned her
M.D. degree at Stanford University, and did her residency training in obstetrics and gynecology at
UCLA and Stanford University. She did a fellowship in molecular biology at Stanford University and
completed her fellowship in Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI) at UCSF and is double
board-certified in Obstetrics and Gynecology/Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility. Dr.
Westphal joined the full-time faculty at Stanford University in 1998 and was a Professor in the
Department of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Director of the Fertility Preservation Program, Director of
the Third-Party Reproduction Program, and Director of the REI Fellowship. Her interest in fertility
preservation for cancer survivors led her to set up one of the first oocyte cryopreservation
programs in the country. She has held numerous national leadership positions and was the President
of the Fertility Preservation Special Interest Group of the American Society of Reproductive
Medicine from 2008-2009. She was the Director of Women’s Health at Stanford from 2005-2012. In 2012,
she co-founded the Stanford Center for Health Research on Women and Sex Differences in Medicine
(WSDM) and served as co-director of the program for two years.

[ View More ][126]

###### Dr. Amber Cooper

CMO, Genomics + Lab Operations & REI
[View More][127]

Dr. Amber R. Cooper, MD, MS is Chief Medical Officer-Genomics and Laboratory Sciences, and Medical
and IVF Practice Director, St. Louis. Prior to joining Kindbody, Dr. Cooper was a founding physician
and the Chief Medical Officer for the St. Louis region of Vios Fertility Institute. She understands
the challenges of infertility both personally and professionally. Board certified in both Obstetrics
and Gynecology and Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility, she completed both her residency and
fellowship at Washington University in St. Louis. During her years of practice, Dr. Cooper has
received numerous awards and has authored articles for several medical journals and textbooks.

She is a globally recognized expert on the topic of artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to
increase access to fertility treatments. In 2022, Dr. Cooper presented at the first world conference
on AI and fertility in Croatia, and more recently spoke on the topic at The Middle East Fertility
Conference in Dubai.

Additionally, she has led clinical studies, had her research covered in the local and national
press, and spoken both nationally and internationally on various topics related to fertility. While
she is passionate for all facets of fertility health, she has a special interest in improving IVF
success and outcomes, fertility preservation, ovarian dysfunction, ovarian reserve and aging,
hysteroscopic surgery, genetics, and the environmental impact on ovarian aging and function.

treatments. We are the only clinic in Africa using this electronic witness system.**

# Welcome and Thank You for Visiting

## At Medfem we believe in helping you reach your family dream through:

**.: World-Class Fertility for Everyone – we believe in making world-class fertility treatments
available for everyone**

**.: A Positive Fertility Journey – It is our joy and commitment to give you a positive outcome to
your fertility journey**

**.: Delivered With Empathy & Caring – So you may have a fond memory, of a feeling of empathy,
caring and being part of the Medfem family**

**.: RI Witness system –** **Medfem has over the past 13 years been using the RI Witness system. The
system helps to mitigate the risk of human error every time samples are moved from one dish or tube
to another, and safeguards every step of the IVF cycle. Ensuring a higher success rate in our IVF
treatments. We are the only clinic in Africa using this electronic witness system.**

## In Vitro Fertilization Procedure

1. IVF at the IVF Treatment in Pune is a complex procedure aimed at helping those who have problems
with conceiving to become parents.

2. Sperm and egg are mixed in the laboratory at the IVF center which is an ideal option for those
who can’t conceive naturally.

3. Hormone injections are given to the woman at the IVF center for the purpose of creating multiple
eggs within the ovaries.

4. These are then collected through a procedure that involves puncturing the ovaries using the
ultrasound scanning method.

5. The embryos, which are then obtained from the laboratory at the Fertility Clinic in Pune then
fertilized by sperm. This can be a normal process or the doctor may use intracytoplasmic sperm
injection (ICSI) whereby a single sperm is injected directly into the egg.

6. The fertilized eggs at IVF Center in Pune are left in the fallopian tubes become embryos.

7. The best embryos are then collected at the ivf center because its have a high IVF Success Rate in
Pune and genetically tested before placing them back in the uterus through a thin tube.

8. There is also an option at the Male Fertility Treatment Pune to preserve any live embryos, which
may be useful in future.

9. After that, there is a certain waiting period during which the female partner has to undergo

## In Vitro Fertilization Procedure

1. IVF at the IVF Treatment in Pune is a complex procedure aimed at helping those who have problems
with conceiving to become parents.

2. Sperm and egg are mixed in the laboratory at the IVF center which is an ideal option for those
who can’t conceive naturally.

3. Hormone injections are given to the woman at the IVF center for the purpose of creating multiple
eggs within the ovaries.

4. These are then collected through a procedure that involves puncturing the ovaries using the
ultrasound scanning method.

5. The embryos, which are then obtained from the laboratory at the Fertility Clinic in Pune then
fertilized by sperm. This can be a normal process or the doctor may use intracytoplasmic sperm
injection (ICSI) whereby a single sperm is injected directly into the egg.

6. The fertilized eggs at IVF Center in Pune are left in the fallopian tubes become embryos.

7. The best embryos are then collected at the ivf center because its have a high IVF Success Rate in
Pune and genetically tested before placing them back in the uterus through a thin tube.

8. There is also an option at the Male Fertility Treatment Pune to preserve any live embryos, which
may be useful in future.

9. After that, there is a certain waiting period during which the female partner has to undergo
pregnancy tests in order to establish that the transfer has been successful.

# TURBOPOWER FOR SPERM CELLS

**BEFORE**
[Deutlich höhere Konzentration der Spermien nach der 3-monatigen Einnahme von PROFERTIL®]**AFTER**

#### Highly effective.

A spermiogram assesses the concentration, mobility and shape of sperm cells. The video on the right
shows the distinct difference after 3 months of taking PROFERTIL®.

[expand_more][44]

## UNIQUE PERFORMANCE

[PROFERTIL® ist das erste diätetische Lebensmittel zur Optimierung der Spermienqualität.]

#### In brief:

Male infertility has many causes – in industrialized countries, genetics, stress, changes in life
patterns and dietary habits all lead to dramatic reductions in sperm cell production and quality.
PROFERTIL® is a clinically-tested and patented formula, developed specifically to optimize sperm
quality and to treat male sterility. Clinical studies show that taking PROFERTIL® for at least 3
months significantly improves sperm quality. No other formula has beaten its pregnancy rate of 25.8
– 41.3%.

[expand_more][45]

## PROFERTIL® REDUCES DNA-BREAKS

#### “Brittle” sperm DNA can significantly increase the likelihood of miscarriage.

#### Breaks in sperm DNA strands greatly increase the chances of miscarriage

Breaks in the sperm-DNA (= DNA-fragments) can lead to embryo arrest. PROFERTIL® has been shown to
reduce DNA-breaks in sperm cells after 3 months of use.

[> Find out more][46]

area of 9,900 square meters. We are one of the largest professional manufacturers of wheel aligners,

system including 7 sale branch offices and more than 30 net service points. Working in line with the

### Partner With The Wellness Store®

Are you a health, wellness, or nutrition brand looking to expand your retail presence in the UK? At
The Wellness Store, we partner with forward-thinking brands that prioritise quality, innovation, and
customer wellbeing. We are always looking to introduce high-quality products that align with our
mission of making better health accessible, convenient, and trusted.

### Why Partner With Us? Established Physical Retail Presence

We currently retail through two physical stores in Glasgow, serving a growing and loyal customer
base. Alongside our retail locations, we operate online — allowing customers across the UK to access
our carefully curated wellness range. With expansion plans underway, we aim to open additional
stores in the coming months, creating further retail opportunities for our partner brands.

active motion.

Progressive Motility is the percentage of sperm cells that are making forward progress, not just
